acceptanceScope: Frozen fixed-view Safe WebGL research-candidate visual, semantic, reproducibility, private attribution and delivery-byte gates; not deployment authorization or arbitrary-view/real-device quality certification.

runtimeSpeedup.reason: SwiftShader wall-clock samples are scheduling-confounded; concurrent ancillary work and uncontrolled driver/OS caches prevent attribution.

limitations: Fixed cameras and occlusion limit quality conclusions; no arbitrary-view parity claim.
Dense wireframes and opaque silhouettes do not prove hidden-detail parity.
Cold compilation means before first model render, not globally cold driver caches.
Authentic attribution evidence remains private and cannot be fully revalidated from a clean public checkout.
disposition: Retain the FINAL artifact as the accepted research result. Preserve rejected candidates and all correction evidence. Keep the original public Estuary control deployed pending a separately authorized integration package.
